comments.content: containerSeemsToBeEmptyDomElement slices t.symbol.Name[4 : len(t.symbol.Name)-7] without first ensuring len >= 11. For a name that has the HTML…Element prefix/suffix but is shorter than 11 chars the slice bounds are invalid and will panic. Guard the length before slicing, e.g. if len < 11 { return false }.

The early-out checks `c.compilerOptions.Lib == nil || slices.Contains(c.compilerOptions.Lib, "lib.dom.d.ts")`. In the TypeScript compiler the lib option is expressed as "dom" not "lib.dom.d.ts", and a nil Lib usually means defaults are in effect. This condition may incorrectly suppress the TS2812 diagnostic when lib is nil or when the lib list contains "dom". Verify the representation used by the Go port and adjust the check to match the actual lib values.
